title: Your computer has “4 minutes to quarantine”
scenario: A browser warning fills the screen and plays an alarm. It says your photos are being encrypted and gives a support number to call before a four-minute quarantine countdown reaches zero.

answers.A: Do not call the number; close the browser if possible and use your device’s trusted security tools or a known support provider.
answers.B: Disconnect from the internet and ask a trusted person or support provider to inspect the device.
answers.C: Call the displayed number but refuse to install anything until they prove they are legitimate.

explanation: Scare screens use urgency to make the attacker the only apparent helper. The support channel shown by the warning is part of the warning.
proTip: The alarm is part of the persuasion.
